oracle: X is directly readable at a registered opposite corner of V, so balanced hard decode accuracy oracle=1; S and ordinary coordination alone have oracle=.5. Shell forecast oracle MSE gains and information scores as in train-design.json.
fit: For each frozen neural encoder, argmax over its four logits. Align each state to its majority X in FIT pseudo-parents only (exact tie/empty -> 0). Independently fit the majority-X nuisance-only S map. No holdout labels for alignment/sign.
test: On independent pseudo-parents use balanced accuracy = 0.5*(sensitivity+specificity). Report 95% intervals via averaging Bonferroni-adjusted Wilson intervals for the two binomial recalls; one letter per parent. Shuffle held-out X within (fake beta,z), PCG64 94831, keep predictor fixed and evaluate the same statistic. Also report unpermuted central decode in the shuffled-SHELL control: removing E-X does not make the explicit V-X relation false, so this descriptive central decode alone is not a test of relevance.
gate: For BOTH weak and strong trials, across ALL four arms, hard decoder lower95 > .75; matched heldout-label shuffle balanced accuracy within [.49,.51] and nuisance-only within [.49,.51]. On the shuffled-shell trial require the originally registered null bounds and MSE/expected-log-score separation, not a chance unpermuted hard decode. No retries, winner picking or seed substitution; failure is a failed synthetic qualification and cannot release physical learning.
streams: For fixed seed and denominator, all arms reuse identical randomized beta group sequence and common proposed parent order/translation uniforms each sweep; then uniform/matched apply law-specific constraints and padding. For fixed law both architectures share exact physical index tuples; SHA256 of actual rows by beta/role/law/seed and fixed eval draws attest sharing. Different seeds are independent starts. No claim that unmatched and matched tuples are identical.
